project_title: Flight Delay Prediction and Statistical Intelligence System

selection_protocol.split_type: Strict chronological out-of-time (Fit: 2019-2021 [1.78M flights], Val: 2022 [504k flights], Test: Sep 2022-Aug 2023 [632k flights])
selection_protocol.leakage_policy: Zero post-departure leakage. Only pre-departure timetable and strictly prior-day (< FL_DATE) causal history features used.
selection_protocol.class_balancing_policy: No synthetic sampling, SMOTE, or artificial resampling. Evaluated entirely on genuine operational class distribution.
selection_protocol.classification_primary_metric: Validation delayed-class F1-score with validation-optimized decision threshold

selected_classification_models.name: XGBoost Classifier
selected_classification_models.selection_rationale: Highest validation delayed-class F1 score (0.4510) and validation PR-AUC (0.4213) among all candidate classifiers.

selected_classification_models.name: HistGradientBoosting Classifier
selected_classification_models.selection_rationale: Second-highest validation F1 (0.4484) with highest delayed-class recall (62.30% val, 59.89% test) and native categorical handling.

selected_classification_models.name: LightGBM Classifier
selected_classification_models.selection_rationale: Third-highest validation F1 (0.4479) with highest test precision (36.88%) and overall accuracy (68.79%).

selected_classification_models.name: Logistic Regression
selected_classification_models.selection_rationale: Strongest linear model (val F1 = 0.4472), exceeding Random Forest and Extra Trees; provides an interpretable probabilistic benchmark.

selected_regression_models.name: LightGBM Regressor
selected_regression_models.selection_rationale: Lowest validation MAE (17.8043 min) and lowest test MAE (18.5561 min), cutting error by 18.09% over the training mean baseline.

selected_regression_models.name: HistGradientBoosting Regressor
selected_regression_models.selection_rationale: Second-lowest validation MAE (17.8662 min) with lowest test Median Absolute Error (5.1490 min).

selected_regression_models.name: XGBoost Regressor
selected_regression_models.selection_rationale: Third-lowest validation MAE (17.8945 min), highly competitive across all error percentiles.

selected_regression_models.name: Gradient Boosting Regressor
selected_regression_models.selection_rationale: Fourth-lowest validation MAE (17.9840 min), providing a pure Scikit-Learn tree boosting baseline.
